summary: New AI21 Studio accounts receive a $10 credit good for three months on the AI21 platform (REST APIs, SDK, and playground). After the credit is used or expires, valid billing information is required to continue. Cloud-hosted AI21 models (Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure) are billed by those providers, not this credit. A marketing-page claim of a 7-day window was not independently verified (pricing site 403); this listing follows the official docs.
claim_steps: Create an AI21 Studio account (no credit card required to start).
Use the $10 credit on APIs, SDK, and playground for up to three months.
Add billing information after the credit is used or expires to continue.

social_proof.title: Pricing - AI21 Labs
social_proof.text: New accounts are given a $10 credit good for three months on the AI21 platform. You can use your credit for all usage of the APIs, the SDK, and the playground.
